name: Ollama / zerollama
description: Local and self-hosted Ollama-compatible inference for text, embeddings, tool calls, structured output, speech, and transcription.

OLLAMA_BASE_URL.label: Ollama Base URL
OLLAMA_BASE_URL.help: Base URL of the Ollama-compatible server. A trailing /api is optional.

OLLAMA_API_ENDPOINT.label: Ollama API Endpoint
OLLAMA_API_ENDPOINT.help: Higher-precedence endpoint alias; values with or without /api are accepted.

OLLAMA_API_URL.label: Ollama API URL
OLLAMA_API_URL.help: Compatibility endpoint alias used when OLLAMA_API_ENDPOINT is unset.

OLLAMA_SMALL_MODEL.label: Small Model
OLLAMA_SMALL_MODEL.help: Model tag for nano, small, and medium text calls unless separately overridden.

OLLAMA_LARGE_MODEL.label: Large Model
OLLAMA_LARGE_MODEL.help: Model tag for large and mega text calls unless separately overridden.

OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_MODEL.label: Embedding Model
OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_MODEL.help: Ollama model tag used for TEXT_EMBEDDING.

OLLAMA_TTS_MODEL.label: Speech Model
OLLAMA_TTS_MODEL.help: Enables TEXT_TO_SPEECH through POST /v1/audio/speech when set.

OLLAMA_TTS_VOICE.label: Speech Voice
OLLAMA_TTS_VOICE.help: Optional voice identifier sent to the speech endpoint.

OLLAMA_TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL.label: Transcription Model
OLLAMA_TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL.help: Enables TRANSCRIPTION through POST /v1/audio/transcriptions when set.
